claims.nodeLabel: Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications Program (AAWSAP)
claims.text: DIA published solicitation HHM402-08-R-0211, 'ADVANCED AEROSPACE WEAPON SYSTEM APPLICATIONS PROGRAM', as a Combined Synopsis/Solicitation on FedBizOpps, original posted date 18 August 2008, response date 05 September 2008 4:00pm Eastern, original archive date 31 October 2008. Set aside: Total Small Business. Classification Code 'B -- Special studies and analysis - not R&D'. NAICS 541330 Engineering Services, size standard $25 million. Issued by the Virginia Contracting Activity for 'engineering services in the Washington DC area'. 'One firm fixed price contract is anticipated to be awarded as a result of this' solicitation.

claims.nodeLabel: Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications Program (AAWSAP)
claims.text: The solicitation was issued through the Virginia Contracting Activity (VCA), DIA's contracting arm, and coded 'B -- Special studies and analysis - not R&D' rather than as R&D. Combined with the Total Small Business set-aside on a $10M congressional add, this is a procurement structure that minimises public visibility: VCA awards are largely absent from public FPDS/USAspending data (confirmed: FPDS ATOM query for PIID HHM402-08-C-0072 returns an empty feed).

b.label: Bigelow Aerospace Advanced Space Studies (BAASS), LLC

edges.note: BAASS was the only bidder and the performer. DIA's own record: 'DIA received only one bid, from Bigelow Aerospace Advanced Space Studies (BAASS), in response to the RFP. DIA determined that the proposal was responsive.' A twelve-technical-area solicitation drawing a single bid is itself a fact about how the work was scoped.

a.label: Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications Program (AAWSAP)

edges.note: The contract is the instrument the programme ran on. HHM402-08-C-0072 was signed 22 September 2008 off solicitation HHM402-08-R-0211, which DIA had posted as a Combined Synopsis/Solicitation on FedBizOpps on 18 August 2008 with responses due 5 September. Worth carrying: the contract does not appear in public federal contract data - an FPDS-NG ATOM query for that PIID returns an empty feed.

a.label: Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications Program (AAWSAP)

edges.label: the only case where money for a UAP programme has been traced from a classified appropriation to a named contract
edges.note: Roughly $22 million was placed in the classified defense appropriation at the direction of Senate leadership and spent through DIA solicitation HHM402-08-R-0211 and the resulting prime contract. AAWSAP is therefore the domain's proof of concept: it establishes that money for exactly this subject can and did move through the classified channel, and that it becomes visible only when a contract number surfaces.

a.label: Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications Program (AAWSAP)

edges.label: 26 FY2009 + 12 FY2010 technical reports
edges.note: The DIRDs are the contract's deliverables. DIA Talking Paper U-973-09 records that the RFP broke the work into twelve technical areas - lift, propulsion, control, armament, signature reduction and the rest - and the Defense Intelligence Reference Documents are the products those areas were delivered as. Every one of the 32 series-member edges was verified against the released PDF's cover page on 22 August 2026.

a.label: Bigelow Aerospace Advanced Space Studies (BAASS), LLC

edges.label: a company stood up to hold a single government contract
edges.note: BAASS was registered as a legal entity distinct from Bigelow Aerospace, with its own DUNS and CAGE codes, in order to bid and hold DIA contract HHM402-08-C-0072. Standing up a corporate vehicle for the purpose of receiving one award is a contracting mechanic, and it is the one instance on this board that is fully documented in FOIA-released procurement paper.

edges.label: the instrument itself - competed, awarded, numbered and released
edges.note: Awarded 22 September 2008 off solicitation HHM402-08-R-0211 through the DIA Virginia Contracting Activity. It is the domain's reference specimen: the object that shows what a contract for this subject looks like when the paper survives, against which every undocumented allegation of a contract can be compared.

edges.label: the one instrument on the board where the appropriation-to-contract path is fully documented
edges.note: The AAWSAP prime contract, awarded 22 September 2008 to BAASS off solicitation HHM402-08-R-0211 through the DIA Virginia Contracting Activity, and released through DIA FOIA together with modification P00001. It is the concrete artefact that turns 'money moved through a classified channel' into a document with a number on it, which is what this domain exists to collect.
